propositions: A new Pass-1 overlay prompt document for code-review concurrency dimension must be authored and committed to src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-concurrency.md following the established pattern of security and performance overlays.

The rubric must enforce a lockset-first quartet: concurrency source named, sibling accessor with guard cited, all four race elements (shared resource, ≥2 executors, interleaving window, concrete harm), and disposition-aware guard suppression with defer-by-name routing to security and performance.

The frontmatter must mirror code-review-security.md with keys outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, and langfuse_prompt; the prompt must instruct criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and state empty findings are expected.
The prompt file is inert until registered by dependent story errable-tricksome-ape, which adds OVERLAY_IDS entry, routing, and gate dispatch; this ticket delivers the document artifact only.
Behavioral validation deferred to standing eval story ironfisted-humble-shrew; in-session validation is structural: frontmatter parse and grep for required rubric sections.
